items.title: Newcastle to appoint Jaissle as new boss tomorrow after Howe exit confirmed
items.summary: Newcastle are set to announce Matthias Jaissle as their new head coach on Saturday after Eddie Howe's exit was confirmed.

items.title: American Affair flies the flag for Goldie at Goodwood
items.summary: Scottish speedball American Affair bounced back to form to claim top honours in the King George Qatar Stakes at Goodwood.

items.title: Dunkley and Gardner lead Rockets to dominant win over Super Giants
items.summary: Trent Rockets ended the Manchester Super Giants’ unbeaten start to The Hundred after handing them a 31-run defeat at Old Trafford Cricket Ground thanks to half-centuries from Sophia Dunkley and Sophie Luff and a four-wicket haul by Ash Gardner.

items.title: Chelsea sign Italy's Dragoni from Barcelona
items.summary: Chelsea sign Italy attacking midfielder Giulia Dragoni from Barcelona on a four-year contract.

items.summary: Hayden Mullins leaves his role as Fulham Under-21 boss to become the new head coach of League Two side Newport County.

items.title: F1 contracts: How long is each driver signed up for?

items.summary: Fifa's chief operating officer strongly criticises Gianni Infantino's plan to sell stakes in competitions to private investors.

items.title: Why Africa could back controversial Fifa plan
items.summary: Fifa's plan sell stakes in its competitions to private investors has been heavily criticised, but the body running African football is yet to take a side.
